Build competition and density metrics for any set of years

Source: R/build-metrics.R
npc_build_metrics.Rd

Reads organizations for the requested years, attaches market populations, and computes the requested metrics (see npc_metrics()) for each geography level and resource. Returns a tidy long table (or wide tables) and can write the results with a manifest of what was used.

Usage

npc_build_metrics(
  years,
  geo = c("cbsa", "county"),
  resources = c("TOTREV", "TOTEXP", "NETASS"),
  metrics = "default",
  universe = c("filers", "registered", "grassroots"),
  source = c("archive", "nccs"),
  dir = NULL,
  subsection = 3,
  include_imputed = TRUE,
  exclude_churches = FALSE,
  cbsa = c("crosswalk", "geocode"),
  window = 1,
  density_model = c("negbin", "poisson", "loglinear"),
  small_max = 1e+05,
  large_min = 1e+07,
  drop_incomplete_years = TRUE,
  absent_years = NULL,
  drop_ppa_revocations = FALSE,
  format = c("long", "wide"),
  out_dir = NULL
)

Arguments

years

Integer vector of tax years, for example 2012:2022.

geo

Geography levels: "cbsa", "county", or both.

resources

Resource columns for the resource-based metrics, any of "TOTREV", "TOTEXP", "NETASS", "TOTASS".

metrics

Metric ids from npc_metrics(), or "default" for every metric valid for universe.

universe

Which organizations:

"filers"

Form 990 and 990-EZ filers, with financial data.

"registered"

Every organization on the IRS registry that year, with FILER_TYPE "990", "990EZ", "990PF", "990N" or "NONFILER" (see npc_build_registered()). Financial columns are filled for filers only.

"grassroots"

Registered organizations that did not file a 990 or 990-EZ: FILER_TYPE "990N" or "NONFILER".

The registered and grassroots universes add FILING_REQ_CODE, FOUNDATION and CHURCH, and are built on first use under npc_cache_dir(), with the filers taken from source.

source

"archive" reads the local Parquet archive built from the SOI panel. "nccs" reads a live build from NCCS downloads (see npc_build_nccs()), downloading and building any missing years first.

dir

Archive directory for source = "archive" (default npc_archive_dir()) or cache directory for source = "nccs" (default npc_cache_dir()).

subsection

501(c) subsections to keep, or NULL for all.

include_imputed

Keep rows that fill gap years between filings. They have no financial data but mark years when the organization existed. Filers universe only.

exclude_churches

Drop churches that are not required to file (BMF filing requirement code 6). Registered and grassroots universes only.

cbsa

How to assign CBSAs: "crosswalk" (default) maps each county to its CBSA under the 2023 delineation (cbsa_county_xwalk), matching the population data; "geocode" uses the CBSA assigned when the address was geocoded (archive filers only).

window

Number of years pooled for each reported year. With window = 3, the value for 2020 uses 2018-2020: each organization's financial values are averaged over the years it appears, its location and subsector come from its latest year, and population is the three-year average. Counts are then organizations active at any point in the window. Use it to steady metrics for small markets.

density_model

Model for DENSITY_PCTL_N and DENSITY_PCTL_R; passed to get_scale_free_density() as model.

small_max

Organizations with a resource value below this are "small". The default is $100,000.

large_min

Organizations with a resource value at or above this are "large". The default is $10 million.

drop_incomplete_years

Drop reported years whose data (including the earlier years of a window) hold a partial panel, judged against the year counts of the whole archive or live build (see npc_archive_info()).

absent_years

For the dynamics metrics (ENTRY_RATE, EXIT_RATE, NET_GROWTH, CHURN_RATE, GRADUATION_RATE, DOWNGRADE_RATE; see get_dynamics()): years of absence that confirm an exit. Defaults to 2 for filers and 1 for the registered and grassroots universes. Dynamics read absent_years years before the first reported year and absent_years - 1 years after the last, when available, and are not part of metrics = "default".

drop_ppa_revocations

Leave the mass revocations of 2010-2012 out of exits; see get_dynamics().

format

"long" (one row per market, metric and resource) or "wide" (a named list of tables, one per geography and resource).

out_dir

Optional directory. When set, results are written there as CSV along with manifest.csv.

Value

For format = "long", a tibble with GEO_LEVEL, GEO, SUB, YEAR, UNIVERSE, RESOURCE, METRIC and VALUE. Metrics that do not depend on the resource (counts, age, commercial share, ...) appear once, with RESOURCE = NA. For format = "wide", a named list of tibbles such as cbsa_TOTREV (or cbsa when no requested metric depends on the resource). Both carry a "manifest" attribute describing the build.

Rows with GEO = "ALL" are national: they include organizations outside any market of that level (for example, outside every CBSA), and their POP is the U.S. population from pop_county.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
options( npcompete.archive_dir = "D:/data/npcompete-archive" )

m <- npc_build_metrics( 2015:2020, geo = "cbsa", resources = "TOTREV" )
subset( m, GEO == "35620" & SUB == "ALL" & METRIC == "HHI" )

# Density and age only, three-year windows, county level
npc_build_metrics( 2014:2022, geo = "county", window = 3,
                   metrics = c( "DENSITY_PER_100K", "MEDIAN_AGE" ) )

# Live build from NCCS downloads (cached under npc_cache_dir())
npc_build_metrics( 2019:2021, geo = "cbsa", resources = "TOTREV",
                   source = "nccs" )
} # }
